HelpCenter.title: Help Center
HelpCenter.subtitle: Resolve your doubts on how to set up and use Propi quickly and easily.
HelpCenter.searchPlaceholder: What do you need to know?
HelpCenter.noResults: No results found for your search.
HelpCenter.q1: How do I set up my restaurant?
HelpCenter.a1: In the '1. Business Details' section of Settings, you can enter your Trade Name, Legal Name, Country, Currency, and upload your establishment logo. Don't forget to click 'Save data' to apply changes.
HelpCenter.a2: In '2. Team & Payout Account', type the name in the 'Employee name' box and click 'Add'. A label will be created with the 'Pending IBAN 🔗' button. Clicking on it will copy a unique link to send via WhatsApp or email. The employee will open this link once to securely save their bank account.
HelpCenter.q3: How do I connect my payout account?
HelpCenter.a3: In the '2. Team & Payout Account' block, click the 'Manage Stripe' button. This will redirect you to Stripe's secure gateway to link your restaurant's bank account.
HelpCenter.q4: How do I create a table with a QR?
HelpCenter.a4: In the '3. Table, QR & NFC' section, select the location type, choose whether the customer chooses an employee or if it's fixed, define the percentage and suggested tips, and click 'Create QR/NFC'. The table will appear below with the 'Table Card 🎨' option to download or print the QR design.
HelpCenter.q5: How do I use NFC tags?
HelpCenter.a5: Follow the 3 steps indicated in your panel: 1. Buy neutral NFC stickers (NTAG213 or NTAG215). 2. Download the free 'NFC Tools' app on your phone. 3. In the list of created tables, click 'Copy NFC URL', open NFC Tools, go to 'Write' -> 'Add record' -> 'URL', paste the link, and bring your phone close to the sticker to encode it.
HelpCenter.a6: Tips are assigned to the corresponding employee based on the scanned table or QR. In your main 'Tips & Team' menu you can check the breakdown in the 'Tips by employee' table with their totals received, paid, and pending balance.
HelpCenter.a7: You can choose this in the 'Who covers service costs?' selector in Business Details. If you select 'The Customer', a €0.10 surcharge + processing fees will be added at checkout so the employee receives the full tip. If you select 'The Restaurant', the customer will only pay the tip they choose, and processing/commission fees will be deducted directly from the amount the employee receives.
HelpCenter.q8: How does the employee receive their money?
HelpCenter.a8: Stripe manages the transfer of funds directly to the bank account the employee registered via their personal link. Propi collects accounts with maximum security and never stores them on its servers.
HelpCenter.q9: Can I change a table or an employee?
HelpCenter.a9: Yes. To delete an employee or a created table, click on the 'X' or the 'Delete' button next to their name in the Settings section.
HelpCenter.q10: What do I do if a QR doesn't work?
HelpCenter.a10: Click the 'Test QR ↗' button that appears on each table card inside the panel to verify that the payment page opens correctly.
HelpCenter.q11: What do I do if I have a problem with Stripe?
HelpCenter.a11: Click 'Manage Stripe' in the Team section to check the connection status or verify if any data is missing for verification in Stripe.
HelpCenter.a12: If you have additional questions, you can click the 'Contact support' button at the bottom of this help center to send us an email directly.
HelpCenter.contactSupport: Contact the support team and tell us what you need to get help instantly.
